topic: Nami was never seven million beli from freedom: Arlong's own words in chapter 81 show the 100 million deal could never buy her exit
title: Nami Was Never 7 Million Beli From Freedom
description: Everyone says Nami was seven million beli short in chapter 80. Arlong's own words in chapter 81 suggest the number never mattered. Do you think Arlong would ever have let her go?
comment: Would Arlong ever have freed Nami if she paid in full, or was the deal always a trap?

lines.text: Nami was never seven million beli from freedom.

shot.fallback: anime style navigator girl with orange hair in front of a fish-man tower

lines.text: Everyone repeats that number from chapter 80. I think it hides Arlong's real plan.

shot.fallback: orange haired girl facing a shark fish-man

lines.text: Nami hides 93 million beli for Cocoyasi, and needs 100 million.

shot.fallback: girl burying money under tangerine trees

lines.text: Then Nezumi takes every coin, and Arlong claims he never broke the deal.

shot.fallback: mouse-like marine captain grabbing bags of money

lines.text: Now imagine she pays every last coin.

shot.fallback: girl carrying money bags toward a tower

lines.text: Chapter 81 answers it. Arlong tells Chew he won't let a navigator like Nami slip away.

shot.fallback: shark fish-man talking to a fish-man crewmate

lines.text: He'll free her eventually, but only after she has mapped the entire world.

shot.fallback: shark fish-man grinning over a huge world map

lines.text: And the leash is still there. If Nami runs, Cocoyasi Village pays for it.

shot.fallback: fish-man captain looming over a young woman

lines.text: Here's what people forget. Arlong himself told Nezumi where the treasure was.

shot.fallback: fish-man captain whispering to a marine captain

lines.text: So that money was never a payment. It was bait, and the deal was a leash.

shot.fallback: fish-man holding a leash made of gold coins

lines.text: Maybe he keeps his word if she pays. Chapter 81 says no.

shot.fallback: fish-man captain smirking at a hopeful girl

lines.text: What freed Nami wasn't a price. It was asking Luffy for help.

shot.search: Nami asks Luffy help straw hat
shot.fallback: crying girl with a straw hat placed on her head

lines.text: Which means the truth, with or without the Marines, is that...

shot.fallback: girl wearing a straw hat in a village street

self_check.hook: flat contrarian claim in line 1 naming Nami
self_check.loop: last line 'the truth ... is that...' flows into line 1 'Nami was never seven million beli from freedom'
